scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @ax/server" "npm run dev -w @ax/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ax/schema && npm run build -w @ax/server && npm run build -w @ax/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ax/schema && npm run test -w @ax/server && npm run test -w @ax/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ax/schema && npm run typecheck -w @ax/server && npm run typecheck -w @ax/web
